name: com.midmanstudio.mdix.webgl
description: Unity WebGL support for DixScript (.mdix). Bridges MdixDatabase to mdix-wasm via a .jslib shim so the exact same MdixDatabase/Dix API works in WebGL builds, since mdix-ffi (the native P/Invoke backend used everywhere else) cannot be linked into a WebGL player. First-slice coverage only: LoadStr, GetString, GetInt, GetBool, Exists, EntryCount, Dispose. See README.md for setup and current API coverage.
